name: Swig Life 30 oz Mega Mug with Handle (Scrub Life)
seoTitle: Swig Mega Mug Scrub Life Tumbler for Nurses
metaDescription: A Swig Life 30 oz Mega Mug with handle and straw in the Scrub Life print. Great for nurses who try to stay hydrated through a 12 hour shift.
summary: A big 30 oz mug with a handle and straw for the nurse who keeps promising to drink more water on shift. Scrub Life print included.
whyItWorks: Nurses spend all day reminding patients to drink fluids and then realize at hour ten that they have had two sips of water. A 30 oz mug with a straw makes it easier to grab a quick drink between tasks, and a handle helps when they are carrying it in with a lunch bag, badge, and phone all at once.

The size is the point. Fewer refills means fewer trips to the ice machine on a busy day, and the title says it is dishwasher safe and fits a cup holder, both of which matter to someone with no spare time. The Scrub Life print gives it a clear nursing identity so it does not wander off in the break room. Give it for Nurses Week, a birthday, or as a new job gift for someone starting on a fast unit.
goodToKnow: Larger tumblers may not fit every break room cubby, so it suits nurses with locker or station space.
Check the listing for whether the straw and lid are dishwasher safe too.
Fill it with a few drink mix packets for a fun add on.

faq.q: Is 30 oz too big for a nurse at work?
faq.a: For many nurses it is exactly right, since refills are hard to fit into a busy shift. If space at their station is tight, the 24 oz version may suit better.

faq.q: Is it good for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. Long clinical days and study sessions call for plenty of water, and the handle makes it easy to carry between classes.
